data.title: GTA VI’s Record Launch Puts Human-Made Games in Focus
data.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI arrived after 13 years in development and broke records, Bloomberg reported. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said Rockstar’s game was made without generative AI.

Gordon Bellamy, director of ethics at the USC School of Cinematic Arts, discussed the value of human-made content, the possibility that GTA VI’s launch could reshape holiday spending across the gaming industry, and lessons for smaller studios.

data.title: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Other Banks Near $400 Million Municipal Bond Lawsuit Settlement
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and other Wall Street banks are nearing a settlement of a municipal bond price-manipulation lawsuit for more than $400 million. The proposed amount, negotiated in recent days, could be submitted to a court soon, according to a person familiar with the matter. It is a fraction of the billions of dollars in damages sought by plaintiffs.

The settlement would end a long-running federal class action that advanced to the doorstep of the U.S. Supreme Court and was preparing to go to a jury trial. Local governments, led by Philadelphia, alleged that the banks conspired to artificially raise rates on certain debt instruments and profited at taxpayers’ expense. Representatives of the cities and banks declined to comment on the settlement talks. The financial institutions have denied the allegations in court.

data.title: UK Steel Sector Says UK-EU Deal Favors EU Exporters
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Britain’s steel sector is urging the government to reverse part of its recent deal with the European Union, saying it gives the bloc’s steel exporters an unfair advantage over UK peers.

data.title: Colombian Peso Retreats as Risks Challenge Carry-Fueled Rally
data.description: According to Bloomberg, the Colombian peso is headed for its worst month in more than four years as domestic and international risks weigh on one of the year’s most resilient currencies.

data.title: AI | Anthropic Shares Rise Above $83 IPO Price After Volatile First Nasdaq Week
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Anthropic PBC shares climbed above their $83 initial public offering price as the AI lab looked to end its first calendar week on Nasdaq on a positive note after its record-setting debut.

data.title: Altice International and Creditors Make Progress on 40% Debt Cut
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Altice International and its creditors are advancing a restructuring that would reduce debt by about 40%, and possibly more. Lenders would take control from billionaire Patrick Drahi, people familiar with the matter said.

data.title: Brent Crude Falls More Than 2.00% Intraday to $94.57 a Barrel
data.description: According to Jin10, Brent crude fell more than 2.00% intraday to $94.57 per barrel.

data.title: Commerzbank: Diverging Central Bank Rate Outlooks May Lift FX Volatility in 2027
data.description: According to Jin10, Commerzbank analyst Michael Pfister said in a report that foreign-exchange volatility may rise in 2027 if expectations for central bank interest-rate decisions diverge. Markets have begun pricing in rate hikes by major central banks in recent months, which has helped keep foreign-exchange volatility low this year.

data.title: Bio Protocol Plans to Tie Launchpad Funding to Research Milestones
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Bio Protocol co-founder Paul Kohlhaas said in a post on X that the new Bio Launchpad is being designed to link funding disbursements to research milestones, offer small grants for individual experiments, and create a separate channel through which token holders can voluntarily apply for equity in companies holding the relevant intellectual property. The details are still being developed.

Eighteen projects have previously launched through Bio, raising about $26 million in research funding. The earlier model had issues including grants not being tied to research progress and unclear intellectual property arrangements. SEC staff previously issued a no-action letter for Molecule’s Coin-to-Company model, and Bio is studying a similar approach.

data.title: Franklin Templeton Plans to Add HYPE to Crypto Index ETF Around December 1
data.description: Franklin Templeton plans to add Hyperliquid’s HYPE token to its Franklin Crypto Index ETF around December 1, based on a new filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. According to Odaily, a Fox Business crypto reporter said in a post on X that HYPE would become the fund’s eighth holding.

data.title: Russia to Temporarily Halt Buckwheat Exports to Protect Supply
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Russia will temporarily ban buckwheat exports to protect supplies of the staple amid accelerating inflation.

data.title: Brazil's Leading Soybean Region Sees El Niño Crop Fears Ease After Rains
data.description: According to Bloomberg, rains and vigorous, leafy soybean plants in Brazil’s top soybean region are easing fears that El Niño will cause crop losses in the world’s top producer.

data.title: Dana Telsey Sees Brick-and-Mortar Retail Returning on Experience
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Dana Telsey, CEO of Telsey Advisory Group, said brick-and-mortar retail is making a comeback on experience. Black Friday began slowly on the East Coast as stormy weather that postponed the Macy’s Thanksgiving Parade continued into the morning and subdued lines for some of the year’s biggest in-person deals.

data.title: Chile’s FNE Seeks $80 Million Fine Against Apple Over iOS Competition
data.description: According to Jin10, Chile’s competition regulator, the FNE, asked the country’s antitrust court on Friday to fine Apple about $80 million and order corrective measures, alleging the company abused its dominant position in the iOS operating system market. The FNE said Apple had restricted competition since at least 2019 in app distribution and in-app payments for digital goods on iOS. The regulator said on social media that the requested fine equals 30% of sales from product lines and services related to the alleged violations during the investigation period.

data.title: STOCKS | Anthropic (ANT.O) Extends Gains, Rising 8%
data.description: According to Jin10, Anthropic (ANT.O) extended its gains, with its rise widening to 8%.

data.title: FCC Chair Brendan Carr Wants SpaceX to Advance Its Space-Based Data Center Project
data.description: According to Jin10, FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said he hopes SpaceX (SPCX.O) will fully advance its space-based data center project.

data.title: Binance Blockchain Week to Feature Discussion on Trillions in Onchain RWAs
data.description: Binance announced on X that Nic Puckrin, Yoshi Yokokawa, Emilio Anting, and Catherine Chen will discuss whether traditional markets can bring trillions in real-world assets (RWAs) onchain at #BinanceBlockchainWeek.

data.title: AI Math Breakthroughs Revive Bitcoin Security Fears, but Practical Threat Remains Unproven: K33
data.description: AI advances in mathematics have renewed concerns about Bitcoin’s cryptographic security, but no recent breakthrough has demonstrated a compromise. K33 analysts said Friday that the proposed proof of the Riemann hypothesis, developed by Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge using Claude, and debate over P versus NP do not establish a practical attack, according to The Block.

data.title: Argentina Central Bank Informally Asks Wallets and Crypto Platforms to Curb MEP Dollar and Stablecoin Trades
data.description:
Argentina’s central bank has reportedly informally asked some digital wallets and crypto platforms to curb MEP dollar and stablecoin transactions.

According to Odaily, five financial industry executives said the bank made the requests as recommendations to prevent the gap between the official and MEP exchange rates from widening, but did not ask platforms to ban foreign-exchange trading. For crypto platforms, the bank focused on avoiding swaps between USDT and MEP dollars.

On November 26, USDT averaged about 1,760 pesos in Argentina, compared with about 1,663 pesos for MEP and 1,840 pesos for CCL. The central bank continues to maintain Communication A 7506, which prohibits banks from conducting digital-asset business.

data.title: Aluminum Squeeze Pushes LME Toward Another Crisis as Calls for Action Mount
data.description: According to Bloomberg, a historic squeeze in the global aluminum market began taking hold in early November, prompting increasingly urgent calls for the London Metal Exchange to intervene.
